derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

quality.use: Visual entourage; not certified for fabrication or structural analysis

external_reference_status: Two-step image stage. The concept images were generated in the Ginkgo session from text-only prompts that describe an owner reference set of 9 images pasted into the session on 2026-10-06 (third-party photographs and artworks: a toy-like drone hangar, habitat units, a red ring megastructure, an overgrown capsule car in a pink flower forest, a six-wheeled rover, a Tokyo vertical-farm building and a Tokyo rooftop; described in runs/refset_1007/pass.json). Each single-object reference image then took one concept image as its only image reference (named and hashed in the image record as concept_reference, not distributed). No owner reference photograph was uploaded to any generator. Design-proximity review 2026-11-20: the generated references were compared with the owner's reference photographs; the rover and capsule tram share subject and colourway with two of them but differ in form (see their reference_review); the others are generic types. Provider textures are not distributed; only geometry ships.
dimension_basis: Sci-fi vehicles use the sizes Project Y2K content v061 gave them (twofronts/meshy/ginkgo_props_v061 condition_ginkgo_props.py SPEC, longest horizontal side): capsule tram 9.0 m, six-wheeled rover 5.4 m, drone launcher vehicle 3.2 m, shuttle 12.0 m, drone 1.4 m; each mesh was scaled uniformly so that side matches, and height, width and depth were measured after scaling. The planter box keeps Y2K's 1.9 m length, a real trough length. Real-world heights replace stylised ones for the rest: rooftop water tank pair 3.0 m overall (about 2 m stainless tanks on a 1 m stand; Y2K used 5.2 m), flower clump 0.60 m (the prompt's "about knee high"; Y2K used 0.85 m). Not a physical survey.
reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at 1000 px (from 1024 px): no lettering, logos, plates or brand marks. Image reference: concept W057_b.png (Higgsfield job ea488d3b). Design proximity: The owner's reference photographs for this pass (9 images pasted into Ginkgo session 7ee433c3 on 2026-10-06; extracted from the transcript to a scratch folder for this comparison only, not retained or distributed) were compared with the generated image; the owner's Tokyo rooftop photograph shows generic rooftop tanks among other clutter. Generic type.
rights: Concept and reference images generated on the owner's Higgsfield account (gpt_image_2_5); meshes with Tripo H3.1 through the owner's Higgsfield account (water tanks, rover, capsule tram, drone, launcher, shuttle) or with Meshy-7.1 image-to-3D on the owner's Meshy account (planter box, flower clump). The Ginkgo pass records an owner go-ahead on 2026-10-07 ("go ahead with the plan") that covered generation for the GRANDWHIS world packs, not this library. Generator account entitlements and the Tripo terms not independently audited. Provider textures are not distributed.
